intent: Three families reported the same detail before the disappearances: the missing woman stood awake at an exterior door, listening toward the darkness, although no one else could hear anything. County officials still classify the cases as stress-related wandering or sleepwalking. I add instructions to secure deadbolts, record the time of any unusual behavior, and report sightings without approaching. The tone remains calm enough to make the pattern more disturbing.
emotion: orderly and professional while the pattern grows increasingly strange
